outcome.Summary: Implemented the expression language interpreter from SPEC.md as package `expr` (import `example.com/expr/expr`) in expr/ with four files: lexer.go (tokens for numbers incl. `1.5`, `.5`, `1.`, `1e3`, `2.5E-2`; identifiers with true/false literals; all operators; `unexpected character 'X'` at byte offset), parser.go (recursive-descent with the spec's precedence: right-assoc ternary, ||, &&, equality, comparison, +-, */%^, unary, right-assoc ^ above unary, calls; compile errors for unexpected token/end-of-input, missing `)`/`:`, unknown function, arity), eval.go (float64 semantics: math.Mod, math.Pow, 1/0 booleans, short-circuit &&/||/?:, runtime errors for division by zero at operator position, unknown variable at identifier position, sqrt of negative at name position, non-finite result at position 0; Program.Vars sorted+deduped; public API Compile/Eval/Program.Eval/Program.Vars and *Error formatted "pos: msg"), plus expr_test.go with ~15 test functions covering all of the above with exact error-string assertions. Verified with `go vet ./... && go test ./...` (exit 0) and an external probe program spot-checking tricky cases.
